corpus_name: IP-SAKTI Sahayak - Ayurvedic IP & Regulatory Knowledge Base

sources.name: The Patents Act, 1970
sources.title: The Patents Act, 1970 (Act No. 39 of 1970) - Provisions on Patentability and Traditional Knowledge
sources.authority: Intellectual Property India, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
sources.version: The Patents Act, 1970 (incorporating all amendments till 01-08-2024)
sources.description: Primary statutory authority for patentability in India, specifically Section 3 exclusions (Section 3(p) traditional knowledge, Section 3(e) mere admixture, Section 3(d) incremental innovation) and Section 10(4) mandatory biological source disclosure.

sources.name: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002
sources.title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (Act No. 18 of 2003) - Key Provisions on Intellectual Property and ABS
sources.authority: National Biodiversity Authority, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
sources.version: Act 18 of 2003 (India Code Consolidated Text, noting Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act 2023)
sources.description: Primary statutory framework for Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) in India, governing NBA approvals for IPR applications (Section 6), commercial utilization (Section 3/7), and equitable benefit sharing determinations (Section 21).

sources.name: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules 1945 (ASU Framework)
sources.title: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules 1945 - Provisions Relating to Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani Drugs
sources.authority: Ministry of Ayush / Central Drugs Standard Control Organization, Government of India
sources.version: Act 23 of 1940 & Rules 1945 (Consolidated Provisions for ASU Drugs under Chapter IV-A & Part XVI-A)
sources.description: Primary Indian regulatory framework for Ayurvedic, Siddha, and Unani medicines under Chapter IV-A, establishing legal definitions of ASU drugs (Section 3(a)), patent/proprietary medicines (Section 33EEB), First Schedule classical texts, and Rule 158-B licensing guidelines.

sources.name: WIPO GRATK Treaty 2024
sources.title: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (2024)
sources.version: Final Act of the Diplomatic Conference (gratk_dc_7)
sources.description: Landmark multilateral treaty adopted 24 May 2024 establishing mandatory patent disclosure requirement for inventions materially based on genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge. Enters into force three months after 15 accessions/ratifications pursuant to Article 17.

sources.name: Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit Sharing
sources.title: Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and the Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits Arising from their Utilization
sources.authority: Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)
sources.description: International legal agreement under the Convention on Biological Diversity providing transparent legal framework for fair benefit sharing (Article 5), prior informed consent (Article 6), traditional knowledge protection (Article 7/12), and national compliance monitoring (Article 15/16).

sources.name: Ayush Pharmacopoeial Standards Guidance
sources.title: Ministry of Ayush Guidance on Pharmacopoeial Standards and Regulatory Quality Parameters for Ayurvedic Formulations
sources.authority: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine & Homoeopathy, Ministry of Ayush, Government of India
sources.description: Official Ministry of Ayush guidance on pharmacopoeial quality standards (API/AFI monographs), classical vs patent/proprietary licensing criteria, heavy metal/microbial limits, and Schedule T GMP compliance.

sources.name: TKDL Defensive Prior Art Framework Advisory
sources.title: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) - Public Purpose, Defensive Protection Framework and Access Policy Advisory
sources.authority: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research & Ministry of Ayush, Government of India
sources.description: Official CSIR-Ayush public advisory detailing TKDL's defensive protection purpose, IPC TKRC classification, non-public database status, international patent office agreements, and safe abstention/escalation protocol.
